Evidence of English Language Proficiency
Exemption from the TOEFL/IELTS (English-Speaking Countries)
If you hold (or will earn before starting at Howard) at least a bachelor's degree from one of the following countries, then you do not have to submit a TOEFL/IELTS exam score:
American Samoa
Anguilla
Antigua and Barbuda
Australia
Bahamas
Barbados
Belize
Bermuda
Botswana
British Virgin Islands
Canada (except Québec)
Cayman Islands
Dominica
Fiji
Gambia
Ghana
Grand Turks and Caicos Islands
Grenada
Guam
Guyana
Ireland
Jamaica
Kiribati
Lesotho
Liberia

United States (except Puerto Rico)
